APPROVE

The `break` in the original only exited the inner loop and moved on to the other direction, and `return false` in the helper combined with `||` in `IsAlsoSetLive` does the same (the -1 direction is still checked first). Both methods are well under the threshold, and nothing in the diff should break the build under warnings-as-errors. I judged this from reading the diff and did not build or run the tests.
